reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthFillCategories selector and its sign from toBudgetedAverage, and reads spending via getSheetValue like the sibling actions.

duplication.why: No selection or sign logic is copied; the new action is a short loop over shared helpers.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and one test.

maintainability.why: Easy to own; the inline Math.max(0, ...) clamp adds an unexplained local rule and toBudgetedAverage is reused under an average-specific name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending uses getMonthFillCategories('copyable') rather than its own category query.
